website.note: Confirmed QUELIMMUNE (HDE-approved 2024) plus SCD adult AKI pivotal (NEUTRALIZE-AKI, NCT05758077) and CRS feasibility plus other Breakthrough designations (ESRD, HRS, cardiac surgery).

ctgov.note: Sponsor query returned 7 raw trials but 0 in P1-P3 drug bucket — these are device IDE studies (not classified as drug Phase 1-3 by ctgov.gov phase field). Pipeline reconstructed from 10-K narrative; NCTs verified by issuer disclosure.

pipeline.modality: Extracorporeal immunomodulatory cell-processing device (used inline with CRRT)
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from University of Michigan / Innovative BioTherapies (legacy); developed by SeaStar

indications.indication: Adult acute kidney injury (AKI) requiring continuous renal replacement therapy
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multi-center, open-label, randomized, two-arm pivotal study; 339 subjects planned; composite endpoint of mortality or dialysis dependency at Day 90; conducted under FDA IDE
indications.trial_status: Active, enrolling — 181 of 339 patients enrolled as of March 21, 2026
key_milestones: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation (BDD) granted April 29, 2022
Anticipated enrollment period up to 48 months
PMA submission planned upon trial completion

indications.indication: Cardiorenal syndrome (CRS) in adults with acute or chronic systolic heart failure with worsening renal function or severe RV failure awaiting LVAD
indications.trial_design: Multi-center, open-label, feasibility study; 20 subjects; SCD therapy 4 hr/day for up to 6 consecutive days; safety plus mortality, AMI and IV vasopressor endpoints; conducted under FDA IDE
key_milestones: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation granted September 2023

commercial_product.indication: Critically ill pediatric patients with life-threatening AKI due to sepsis or septic condition, on CRRT
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE) — Approval Order received February 21, 2024

excluded_preclinical: ESRD chronic systemic inflammation (BDD Nov 2024) — investigational, no active enrolling pivotal/IDE trial disclosed
Cardiac surgery adult and pediatric (BDD April 2025) — investigational, no active trial disclosed
Myocardial stunning in hemodialysis (UOM-planned pilot) — pre-launch, no trial active
excluded_legacy_terminated: SCD-003 (terminated September 2013 due to nationwide calcium shortage)
excluded_partner_owned: NCT04898010 hepatorenal syndrome pilot — investigator-initiated (not a SeaStar-sponsored pivotal device study)
